sourceChecks.text: He set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.

articlesRead.locator: The popular dedicated article targets Boaz of Ruth; fixed WEB 2CH3:17 uses Boaz as the name of one bronze pillar, not a person. No person article fits.
